core_products_services.name: Music Supervision
core_products_services.description: Curating high-quality music for visual stories in ads, web series, and films. This includes tracking down copyright owners, negotiating licenses, and commissioning original music.

core_products_services.name: Artist Empowerment and Consulting
core_products_services.description: Empowering Indian indie artists with information, resources, and opportunities. Offers free consultations on licensing deals, contracts, and negotiations.

core_products_services.name: Collaboration Facilitation
core_products_services.description: Curating thriving collaborations between musicians and content creators of all shapes and sizes.

Vision to curate thriving collaborations between musicians and content creators, making visual stories sound incredible.
